tasks.title: P10 — HORS_RMR operand alignment (measure only, no wiring)
tasks.instructions:
### P10 — HORS_RMR operand alignment: measure the aligned immigrant inputs

**MEASURE AND REPORT. Do NOT wire anything.** The values you produce go into the spec by a seat ruling at this run's fold, and only THEN does a later run regenerate P8 and update the join table. That ordering is deliberate: P8's note is citation-coupled to §6's stated figures, so wiring before the spec is updated would couple the note to numbers the spec no longer carries.

**Files:** create `demoflow/probes/run_p10.py` and its GENERATED note `demoflow/probes/P10-hors-operand-alignment.md`. Same P-series shape as P8/P9.

**THE DEFECT, ruled in spec §6 amendment #12(A).** HORS_RMR's immigrant headship (0.5169) and ratio (0.9600) are measured over a census residual that INCLUDES the Québec side of Ottawa-Gatineau, while the arrival flows they multiply come from ISQ's literal `Territoire hors des RMR` row, which EXCLUDES it — ISQ publishes `RMR d'Ottawa-Gatineau` separately with the footnote *Partie québécoise uniquement*, so the territory is SEPARABLE on the ISQ side and INSEPARABLE on the census side (98-10-0621-01 carries exactly one Ottawa-Gatineau member, id 81, geoLevel 503, parented to Ontario). **The ruled principle: the rate's territory must match the flow's territory.** Verify all of that live before building on it.

**WHAT TO DETERMINE, in preference order:**
1. **The EXACT construction, if it is resolvable.** The contaminant is the Ottawa-Gatineau CMA's QUÉBEC PART, which is defined at CSD level, so subtracting whole census divisions is an approximation in both directions. 98-10-0622-01 carries CSDs (geoLevel 5) as well as CDs. If you can resolve the CMA's Québec-part CSD membership from a live StatCan source — the geographic-attribute or correspondence surfaces, or a cube that publishes the QC part directly (43-10-0060-01 carries the two Ottawa-Gatineau halves at geoLevel 505; check whether an equivalent exists with the maintainer × population-characteristics cross) — build the residual EXACTLY and say how you resolved membership. A source that gives the QC part directly beats any subtraction.
2. **Otherwise the whole-CD bracket**, with the variant SELECTED by matching the ISQ row it aligns to rather than by feel. The seat's measured anchors: ISQ's Gatineau QC-part row is 355,971 TOTAL-population persons, which converts to ≈345,000 PRIVATE-HOUSEHOLD persons at this tree's own measured universe ratio (8,308,480 / 8,501,833); the census-side variants measure 285,715 (CD Gatineau alone) / 340,000 (+ Les Collines-de-l'Outaouais) / 363,985 (+ Papineau) private-household persons. Publish the full bracket as the sensitivity whichever you choose, and state the selection rule you applied.

**SEAT-MEASURED FIGURES to reproduce or contradict — publish YOURS either way.** Residual as shipped: 84,785 settled persons, headship 0.5169, ratio 0.9600. Net of CD Gatineau (id 1943, geoLevel 3, classificationCode 2481 — note id 1944 is the CSD at geoLevel 5 and is the wrong member): 50,515 persons, headship 0.5218 (+0.95%), ratio **1.0320 (+7.50%), crossing 1.0**. The other two variants: 48,210 / 0.5228 / 1.0242, and 47,790 / 0.5218 / 1.0230. CD Gatineau holds **40.42%** of the residual's `Before 2016` stock against a 10.35% person weight.

**ALSO MEASURE, because the same question applies and the answer is expected to differ:** the aligned HORS_RMR OWNERSHIP propensity. Spec §6 amendment #12(B) rules that it is NOT to be corrected, because a band-uniform relative scaling of ρ cancels EXACTLY in ED — but the CANCELLATION is the claim, so measure the contamination's size (the seat's figure on the analogous all-households propensity is +1.49%) and report it beside the immigrant figures. If your measurement shows the contamination is materially BAND-VARYING rather than near-uniform, that is fork-class — SEAT_QUESTION and stop, because the cancellation argument would not hold.

**THE NOTE MUST CARRY:** the ISQ-side separability evidence (the workbook's own Gatineau row and its footnote, quoted), the census-side inseparability evidence (0621's single Ottawa-Gatineau member and its Ontario parent), the full bracket, the selection rule and the selected construction, the aligned headship/ratio/ownership figures, the ±5 rounding facts where they apply, and the private-household-vs-total universe conversion stated as the approximation it is.

**PROBE DISCIPLINE — all of it binds** (the note is GENERATED and live-regen byte-diffed; every narrative figure a registered `Fact` via `demoflow/probes/_wds.py`; the depth ladder with "does the measured quantity ENTAIL this sentence?" at every claim; earned verdicts with a mutation-tested floor guard; `json.loads(urlopen(...))` never `pd.read_json`; WDS responses keyed off their own coordinate never `zip`; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for batteries; the glob contract gates must pass). Read `demoflow/probes/run_p8.py` first — it already builds these exact coordinate sets and its helpers are the precedent to reuse rather than re-author.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING. Do NOT edit the spec, the plan, `demand/immigrant_inputs.py`, `probes/run_p8.py` or `probes/P8-immigrant-inputs.md` — the wiring is a later run's work. Run-unique scratchpad subdir. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail.

tasks.title: Sentence corrections — sub-floor premise, ED direction, yr-1 label
tasks.instructions:
### Sentence corrections — three durable claims the tree contradicts

Behavior changes NOWHERE in this task. These are claims that are false or mislabelled as written, each ruled in spec §6/§7 amendment #12. Correct the sentences, pin what is pinnable, and change no numeric output.

**1. `census._zero_support_note`'s premise is FALSE for the committed extract.** It says 98-10-0231-01 "publishes no owner-maintainer rate below 25, so the rate is UNDEFINED there". The extract publishes `15 to 19 years` and `20 to 24 years` at every geography the derivation reads — Québec 20-24 is 17,170 owners of 106,605 households; Montréal (CMA) 6,080 / 52,120; Québec (CMA) 1,585 / 13,270. The same module READS both bands for headship (`_HEADSHIP_BAND_SPEC`, census.py:156) and drops them for ownership (`_AGE_BAND_SPEC`, census.py:141) with no recorded reason. **Correct the sentence to what is true: the derivation spec OMITS the two youngest published bands — a choice in this module, not the data's silence.** Record why the choice stands for now (the ordering constraint below), and verify the note's separate under-15 claim, which is expected to remain TRUE and must not be broken.

**THE BEHAVIOR STAYS.** Do NOT extend `_AGE_BAND_SPEC`, do NOT retire `OWNERSHIP_LATTICE_FLOOR`, do NOT change any rate. Spec §7's amendment-#12 limit carries a BINDING ORDERING CONSTRAINT: the convention is currently the only thing suppressing the age-20 band-entry artifact in D_native (21,353 households, 100% of computed D_native being band-entry mass), so extending the ownership curve below 25 before an age-resolved headship curve lands would multiply that artifact into demand instead of zeroing it. Age-resolved headship first, then the floor. If you find yourself wanting to fix the behavior, that impulse is the finding — report it, do not act on it.

**2. Any sentence in the tree calling the sub-floor convention's effect "optimistic" is SIGN-WRONG where it matters.** The QFE priced both legs in ED's own unit: the NUMERATOR leg (zeroed 18-24 formation terms, additive, 0.195-0.337% of OwnerStock) DOMINATES the denominator leg (multiplicative, 0.96-1.65%) by roughly 30×-200×, and for **ED < 0 — the decline regime the module exists to measure — BOTH legs push PESSIMISTIC.** Find every place the tree states the direction (start with `balance/owner_stock.py` and `demand/formation.py`'s `OWNERSHIP_LATTICE_FLOOR` block) and correct it to the measured two-leg statement, with the crossover named (the legs are equal only at |ED| ≈ 19-21%/yr, against an ISQ-implied stock movement of 0.10-0.63%/yr). State ΔD as the ORDER-OF-MAGNITUDE BOUND it is, never a measurement — it rides the banded headship curve, the single-age-inside-a-band reuse the note itself forbids, and what survives that contamination is the crossover rather than the level.

**3. `excess_demand.py`'s dimensional label is wrong, and its guard invites a false reading.** ED is SCALE-INVARIANT but NOT dimensionless: D and S are annual FLOWS (households/yr) over a stock LEVEL, so it composes as **yr⁻¹**, a net turnover rate. Relabel it. Separately, `MIN_OWNER_STOCK`'s "no modeled geography legitimately carries fewer" invites a reader to think 1,000 is calibrated to the frame; it is not — measured across 744 cells the range is 99,692.3 to 1,189,439.0, so the guard sits exactly 100× below any real value. Keep the VALUE (it correctly bounds arithmetic pathology in a function that takes a bare float and cannot be geography-aware) and disclaim the plausibility reading, noting that a geography-aware band belongs at Task 29 where geography identity exists.

Pin what can be pinned without changing behavior: a test that the sub-25 bands ARE present in the committed extract would have caught claim 1 and is cheap.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING. RED-first on any new test. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail.
